descriptionEn: A force from the Hubei-Henan-Anhui base area, among the earliest Red Army columns to reach northern Shaanxi.

leaderEn: Xu Xiangqian, Chen Changhao, Zhang Guotao, Li Xiannian, etc.

nameEn: Red Seventh Corps Northern Anti-Japanese Advance Detachment
leaderEn: Xun Huaizhou, Le Shaohua, Su Yu, etc.

leader: 徐向前、陈昌浩、李先念等
description: 1936年宁夏战役后组成的西征部队，沿河西走廊向新疆方向前进寻求苏联援助，在马家军围攻下损失惨重；董振堂等于此役牺牲。事件条目待权威史料补充。

name: 琼崖纵队
description: 海南岛革命武装在主力长征后长期孤军奋战，坚持二十余年红旗不倒；具体时间线待权威史料补充。
descriptionEn: Revolutionary force on Hainan Island that held out for over two decades; timeline pending sourced review.

name: 东北抗联
leader: 杨靖宇、赵尚志、赵一曼等
description: 九一八事变后在东北坚持游击战争的抗日武装；与长征主线的关联叙事待权威史料梳理。
leaderEn: Yang Jingyu, Zhao Shangzhi, Zhao Yiman, etc.
